rows.name: actions
rows.description: Right-aligned header slot — a date-range picker, refresh button, etc.

rows.name: kpis
rows.description: Optional KPI strip rendered above the body. DashboardShell owns the tile chrome (big number, subtle label, trend arrow + colour); you pass { label, value, delta?, trend? } data. trend: 'up' = success colour, 'down' = danger, 'flat'/omitted = neutral.

rows.name: kpiMinWidth
rows.description: Minimum KPI tile width passed to the responsive Gallery. Default '180px'.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The dashboard body below the KPI strip (chart grid, status cards). Chart libraries stay in your app.
